content:
# knr-ops: Logs Bucket Implementation

## 1. Base resources — `infra/s3/logs/base/`

**`infra/s3/logs/base/bucket.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    forceDestroy: false
    serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
      rule:
        applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
```

**`infra/s3/logs/base/versioning.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-versioning
spec:
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      status: Enabled
```

**`infra/s3/logs/base/public-access-block.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-pab
spec:
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

**`infra/s3/logs/base/role.yaml`** (IRSA role — namespaced, consumed via ServiceAccount annotation)
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-role
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:role/myapp-logs-${ENV}
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:oidc-provider/${OIDC_PROVIDER}"},
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "${OIDC_PROVIDER}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:${NAMESPACE}:myapp-logs-sa",
              "${OIDC_PROVIDER}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
            }
          }
        }]
      }
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy-attach
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs-role
    policyArnRef:
      name: myapp-logs-policy
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ReadWriteLogs",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:ListBucket",
              "s3:GetBucketLocation"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-sa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:role/myapp-logs-${ENV}
```

**`base/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - versioning.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml
  - role.yaml
```

## 2. Overlays

**`infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: dev
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
  - path: refs-patch.yaml
```
(dev/dev-cluster versioning patches for Versioning and PAB `bucketRef` follow the same pattern.)

**`overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`**: identical pattern, `myapp-logs-prod`, region per env.

**`refs-patch.yaml`** (shared shape in both overlays — fixes dependent resource refs to the renamed bucket):
```yaml
- op: replace
  path: /spec/forProvider/bucketRef/name
  value: myapp-logs-dev
```

## 3. Flux kustomization

Add to **`flux/kustomizations.yaml`**:
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: infra-s3-logs
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  path: ./infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev   # prod overlay from prod cluster's copy of repo
  prune: true
  wait: true
  dependsOn:
    - name: infra-iam                 # OIDC provider must exist first
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
```

## Notes

- `${ENV}`/`${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}` are handled per repo convention — either via `replacements`/`configMapGenerator` patches in each overlay or a `kustomize edit set` CI step; raw placeholders would be replaced by explicit patched values per overlay.
- Prod policy is already scoped (no wildcards), satisfying acceptance criterion 4.
- Secrets: if account-specific ARNs are sensitive, pin them via a SOPS-encrypted ConfigMap referenced by `patchesStrategicMerge`.
